summary: Five-phase plan implementing report section 6's recommended landing: discharge DP-5 (truthLemma's T-imp sorry) with the build-verified 15-line proof, thread the new hpers hypothesis through the two external wrapper call sites, and restructure openBranch_countermodel so its single surviving sorry carries the genuinely-open existential instead of the machine-refuted augmented-frame upward-closure goal. Net effect: Scheme.lean 2 live sorries -> 1, zero new sorries, zero new axioms, zero new definitions or imports. Conjunct 2 over rawEdges is NOT attempted -- it is machine-refuted and the plan lands that as a documented negative in the file's honesty register. A dedicated phase creates a follow-on task for the root-cause Expansion.lean defect (intFImpReuseWitnessAnc? never re-validates its loop-back containment check).
decisions_made: PLAN-TIME DISCOVERY not in the research report: truthLemma has TWO external call sites beyond openBranch_countermodel -- intTruthLemma (Intuitionistic/Completeness.lean:97) and minTruthLemma (Minimal/Completeness.lean:102), both passing arguments positionally. Adding hpers breaks both, so the delegation's 'file in scope is Scheme.lean only' constraint cannot hold literally for the recommended landing. Both wrappers were verified to have NO downstream consumers beyond docstrings, so the fix is contained (~4 lines each). The plan proceeds under the stated assumption that these two edits are in scope as the mechanical closure of a signature change.
Phase 1 is a declared atomic-batch spanning three files (Scheme.lean + the two wrappers). Splitting it would leave the repo build red between commits, violating the every-phase-ends-green constraint.

The preserved spike diff's THIRD hunk must NOT be landed: it passes (by sorry) for hpers at the openBranch_countermodel call site, and hpers is machine-refuted at the augmented frame. Sorrying a refuted statement is exactly what the file's honesty discipline forbids. Phase 1 drops the frame-committing refine line instead.

openBranch_countermodel's now-dead extraction block (the ~40-line intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat invocation) is deleted rather than underscore-kept, because the identical invocation survives verbatim in openBranch_rawEdges_upward_closed directly below in the same file. Underscore-prefixing is the documented fallback.

Annotations must name the root-cause defect by its durable anchor (intFImpReuseWitnessAnc? in Expansion.lean) and NEVER by task number: Cslib/** is a deliverable tree governed by the no-task-references-in-deliverables rule, which is enforced by a blocking write-time hook.

Phase 3 was added beyond the report's scope: discharging DP-5 makes stale the claims in ~6 other files that 'the parametric sorry in truthLemma is the single deferred completeness obligation'. Leaving them is itself an honesty defect. The file list is carried as a Scope Hypothesis to be confirmed by grep at implement time.
